content: The ChatGPT UI reset countdown is DERIVED client-side from a server-provided reset_at unix timestamp returned by /backend-api/wham/usage for each limit window. primary_window = 5-hour rolling window, secondary_window = 7-day (168h) weekly cap; both carry used_percent and reset_at. The 168h cycle in this project maps to the secondary_window. Server also returns rate-limit reset timestamps in 429 responses per model family (ndycode/oc-chatgpt-multi-auth tracks rateLimitResetTimes from API-provided timestamps). Do not compute reset from local observation; trust reset_at.
